# NIST fixture subset

Five files from NIST's *CAD Models and STEP Files with PMI* test
system ([NIST MBE PMI Validation and Conformance Testing
Project](https://www.nist.gov/el/systems-integration-division-73400/mbe-pmi-validation-and-conformance-testing)).

Public-domain (NIST) test data; not developed at peer review. See the
project's [data repository entry](https://data.nist.gov/od/id/ark:/88434/mds00jwkr0).

| file | AP | edition | size |
|------|----|---------|------|
| nist_ctc_01_asme1_ap242-e1.stp | AP242 | 1 | 395 KB |
| nist_ctc_03_asme1_ap242-e2.stp | AP242 | 2 | 674 KB |
| nist_ftc_11_asme1_ap242-e3.stp | AP242 | 3 | 1.9 MB |
| nist_stc_09_asme1_ap242-e4.stp | AP242 | 4 | 968 KB |
| nist_ctc_01_asme1_rd.stp | AP203 | — | 235 KB |

Chosen for: PMI coverage, AP242 edition spread (1→4), one AP203
control. Larger files (FTC-08 at 4.7 MB, FTC-09 at 6.1 MB) stay on
NIST's site — fetch locally if needed for perf work.
